methods.name: CD-TLI (Change detection-based method for co-seismic landslide mapping using tri-temporal logical information)
methods.summary: CD-TLI is a change detection-based method that uses tri-temporal remote sensing images. It involves feature extraction using vegetation indices, change vector analysis (CVA) to generate preliminary change results, logical pattern classification to identify landslide-related changes, automatic sample selection, and an ensemble learning strategy (SVM, RF, MLP) followed by logical fusion to generate the final landslide map.
methods.source: Chenghan Yang, Xin Wang, Shanchuan Guo, Hong Fang, and Peijun Du
methods.verbatim: To solve these problems, inspired by TLCVA, we developed a change detection-based method for co-seismic landslide mapping using tri-temporal logical information (CD-TLI).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the CD-TLI method lacks a repository or persistent link.
